name: Gearbox
text: We should switch to Claude Mythos 5 for EXCAVA prompts, because it's Anthropic's most powerful model in the Fable 5 generation, offering better performance and capabilities. This decision makes sense because it directly addresses our goal of raising EXCAVA's capability, even if only by 0.5%. The trade-off I'm accepting is potentially higher costs or resource requirements, since more powerful models often come with increased computational demands. By choosing Claude Mythos 5, we prioritize quality and capability over cost considerations, aligning with our team law of "quality first".

name: Torque
text: Gearbox ignores the 95% quality benchmark is a Fable 5 synthetic test—real-world EXCAVA prompts hit 78% quality now, so Mythos 5 won’t close that gap. A better move: test Maverick 12B’s "occasional prompt collapses" against our worst 10% of prompts—if it cuts failures by 20%, we gain more than Mythos 5’s 0.5% lift. Run the test; the numbers settle it.
